blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 44 sold over 5 months against an average of 52.2 listed, about 5.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 15 sold. faq.a: No. The Paragon name combines two neighbourhoods named in the former North Delta Area Plan (Schedule C.1, Bylaw No. 3950) — Sunshine Hills (12 of 14) and Sunshine Woods (13 of 14) — and the City publishes no single boundary for the combined name.
